description: ActivePool.sendCollaterals function internally call _sendCollateral, which uses whitelist.getIndex(_collateral) as if it were a validated lookup, but for a non-whitelisted token, it returns 0 (the same index as the first real whitelisted token). As a result, the code silently updates poolColl.amounts[0], i.e., the balance slot of the first whitelisted asset—while actually transferring some other (unsupported) token.
